description: List what visitors asked the chatbot in a period: the first questions of each conversation, without the chatbot's answers. Use this to find what customers ask about most: group the questions by meaning and give examples. Counts you make by grouping are estimates; say so. When Chat Categories is on, the result also carries exact chat counts per category. To read one conversation in full, use get_conversation.

days.description: How many days back to look (1-90, default 30).

per_chat.description: Questions taken from each conversation (1-5, default 2).

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

name: list_visitor_questions
title: List visitor questions
